entryRequirements.summary: Entry requirements cannot be assessed without traveller document details. The Los Angeles connection is part of the US entry assessment.
Return-entry eligibility is not assessed. Residence in Australia does not establish citizenship or entry permission.

lineItems.label: Example airport transfers and local transit allowance
Meal allowance for two over ten travel days

notes: Amounts are fictional estimates for the entire party, not per person.
Alternative options are excluded from the active total.

assumptions: This fixture is for UI development, not a real travel recommendation.
Hotel names and transport schedules are fictional; no booking is confirmed.
The ten days include outbound travel and arrival home, not ten full days in New York.
Flight legs and layovers are invented to test time zones, connections and cross-day UI; no real airline or flight is claimed.
The exchange rate of 1 USD = 1.5 AUD is a fixture constant, not a current quote.
The local transport allowance includes all displayed transfers; repeated references are counted once.
Breakfast and dinner are flexible; the meal allowance covers them even when not individually scheduled.
Luggage storage after checkout is an unverified assumption.
